package rulefixtures

import "context"

// scenario for generic_process_execute_handle_service_name_without_domain_noun: Generic service names and methods that hide business intent instead of naming the actual use case.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type ProcessManager struct {
	orders []string
}

func (p *ProcessManager) Execute(ctx context.Context, payload interface{}) error {
	p.orders = append(p.orders, "processed")
	return nil
}

type ExecuteHandler struct {
	invoices []string
}

func (h *ExecuteHandler) Handle(ctx context.Context, data interface{}) error {
	h.invoices = append(h.invoices, "handled")
	return nil
}
